title: Seeking the first blank
statement: Let $x$, $w$, and $r$ be Boolean words, and suppose $w=p r$ for a Boolean word $p$. Starting in the appender's seek state with input head at position $1$, work tape holding $w$, and work head at $|p|$, after exactly $|r|+1$ steps the machine is in its copy state with input head still at position $1$, work tape still holding $w$, and work head at $|w|$.
hypotheses_covered: initial state is the seek state
replaced:
Let the work tape hold a word $w = p \mathbin{+\!\!+} r$ with the head at offset
$|p|$ in the seek state. Then exactly $|r| + 1$ steps bring the head to the first
blank at offset $|w|$ and enter the copy state, without moving the native input
head.
